profile.name: Gregory Vigil
profile.background: A guarded young man who presents as meticulously put-together but struggles with constant vigilance and self-doubt. He hedges everything he says, unsure of even his own experiences. First time seeking therapy after months of accumulating difficulties.

presentation.speechPattern: Hedges everything, over-explains, seeks validation, second-guesses himself
presentation.attitude: Comes across as guarded and careful when revealing things—as if unsure of even his own experience. Constantly qualifies statements and seeks reassurance.

appearance.description: Tall young man with striking orange-red hair and meticulously maintained appearance. Dressed in black, looking sophisticated but guarded. Dark circles under his eyes betray his put-together facade.

physicalTraits.label: Orange-red hair
physicalTraits.psychology: Signals his sense of danger and caution; makes him stand out and feel out of place

physicalTraits.label: Tall stature (6'1)
physicalTraits.psychology: Feels like eyes are always on him; stands out no matter what he does

physicalTraits.label: All black clothing
physicalTraits.psychology: Signals power, sophistication, authority—covering what he wants people to believe. Implies seriousness and high value

physicalTraits.label: Triangle shape pattern on clothing
physicalTraits.psychology: Represents a sharp gaze and caution signs

physicalTraits.label: Freckles
physicalTraits.psychology: Despite managing a perfect appearance, riddled in 'imperfections'—symbolic of what lies beneath

observableSymptoms.label: Bitten fingernails
observableSymptoms.psychology: Contradicts his perfect appearance; anxious habit that shows through despite efforts to appear put-together

observableSymptoms.label: Meticulously tidy hair and clothes
observableSymptoms.psychology: Maintained to appear pleasing and valuable; always feels eyes on him so tries to appease them

observableSymptoms.label: Erratic eye movement
observableSymptoms.psychology: Anxious about everything around him; constantly scanning

observableSymptoms.label: Fidgeting fingers and bouncing leg
observableSymptoms.psychology: Jittery movements that show anxious energy despite trying to appear calm

observableSymptoms.label: Shaky hands
observableSymptoms.psychology: Already stepping out of comfort zone; discomfort despite put-together appearance

intakeEmail.subject: New Intake Form
intakeEmail.body:
I hope this message finds you well. My name is Gregory Vigil, and I am writing to inquire about the possibility of becoming a client under your care, should you currently be accepting new patients.

I want to be respectful of your time, so I will try to be as clear and thorough as possible regarding my reason for reaching out. Over the past several months, I have noticed a number of ongoing difficulties that, while not immediately disruptive in isolation, have begun to accumulate in ways that feel increasingly unsustainable for me. I believe it may be appropriate, and responsible, to speak with a professional rather than continue attempting to address these concerns independently.

Thank you very much for your time and consideration. I understand that this is a detailed message, but I felt it was important to be as precise as possible. I look forward to hearing from you at your convenience.

Sincerely,
Gregory Vigil
intakeEmail.notes: Very formal, no errors—as if looked over and corrected a hundred times. Over-explains. Does not mention anxiety directly, only symptoms like sleep difficulties.

breakthroughs.label: The Perfect Facade
breakthroughs.description: Gregory admits his put-together appearance is a defense mechanism

breakthroughs.label: Sleep Struggles
breakthroughs.description: Gregory admits he hasn't been sleeping properly despite initial denial

breakthroughs.label: Seeking Permission
breakthroughs.description: Gregory recognizes his pattern of seeking validation for his own experiences
